name: Kobayashi Opera
source:
A member of "Milky Holmes".

The main protagonist of the first PSP game who is said to be the person who trained Milky Holmes. He was named after [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kogoro_Akechi]Yoshio Kobayashi[/url]. In the PSP game, he lost his Toy much the same as the Milky Holmes.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Milky_Holmes]Wikipedia[/url].]
